notes: This is a gentle conversational book in which a child and dog walk through the landscape greeting signs of seasonal change — melting snow, budding trees, returning birds, flowing streams, blooming flowers. The vocabulary skews toward nature nouns and simple descriptors. 'Bird' is already in the existing activity_images vocab which is convenient. 'Stream' is the most book-specific water word (the child converses with a brook/stream). 'Grow' captures the central theme of plants and life returning. Colours (green, yellow) were considered but spring/flower/grow communicate the theme more functionally for AAC use. The hero is a generic unnamed child with a dog drawn in Pak's soft watercolour style — a standard Boardmaker child+dog image is acceptable, though it will not precisely match the illustration aesthetic.
